motion.value: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity 180ms ease, display 260ms allow-discrete, overlay 260ms allow-discrete

appearance.reducedMotion: Explicit reduction or the system preference suppresses transitions and animations; keep static focus, selection, color and disabled feedback.
appearance.application: Restore before first paint; apply CSS properties and data attributes without rerendering chapters or restarting workers; synchronize storage changes.

dataRoles.legendRule: A series and its legend use the same semantic token in both appearances; line style and labels distinguish measured data from model references.

extensions.rampNote: Preview-only OKLCH ramps derived from extracted hue/chroma; runtime tokens remain the exact CSS values in DESIGN.md.

folderMaterial.motionGuard: Fanning requires system no-preference and :root:not([data-motion="reduce"]); explicit or system reduction leaves folder geometry still with title-color/focus feedback.

narrative.overview:
A sober academic notebook with a tactile filing-library entrance: each homework is a clickable crimson-wine folder containing topic-specific papers and formulas. Serif display headings, readable sans-serif prose and neutral scientific panels preserve the established academic identity and concept → experiment → measurement → interpretation sequence.

Charcoal is the default; warm-paper light mode is equally supported. The Display drawer lets the reader tune text size, spacing, width, contrast and motion without restarting experiments. Folder movement and brief control feedback respond to deliberate action, then settle; mathematical plots continue to show computed evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Interactive homework folders with real topic/formula previews.
Locally hosted serif display and readable DM Sans text.
Two coordinated appearances with saved reading preferences.
Neutral scientific panels and matching semantic chart legends.

rules.name: The Series Agreement Rule
rules.body: A series and its legend use the same semantic token in both appearances; line style and labels distinguish measured data from model references.

rules.name: The Quiet Evidence Rule
rules.body: Reserve dimensional material for the homework folders and Display drawer; keep scientific panels neutral and use rules and tonal contrast to organize evidence.

dos: Do support both saved appearances and reading preferences on every chapter.
Do preserve English content, academic identity and the concept → experiment → measurement → interpretation sequence.
Do use real chapter topics and formulas inside folder previews.
Do use semantic series tokens for plots and matching legends.
Do preserve live experiment results when display settings change.
Do keep visible keyboard focus, contained chart/table scrolling and static reduced-motion feedback.
donts: Don't introduce a separate identity or font pairing for another homework.
Don't turn scientific panels into saturated promotional cards.
Don't scale SVG geometry or display headlines with the reading-text slider.
Don't add unattended looping animation or make theme changes move the page layout.
